prompt: WebSearch for the ACP specification limited to one allowed domain, then WebFetch one page with a prompt
notes: Only the session/update notifications whose `_meta.claudeCode.toolName` is WebSearch or WebFetch.
The opening tool_call has an empty rawInput and the adapter's generic title; the request arrives on
the refining tool_call_update, which is where query, allowed_domains, url and prompt live.
WebSearch results are structured, against what this repo assumed: `toolResponse.results` is a list
whose object entries hold `content` arrays of { title, url }, with the model's prose as a sibling
string entry. That update names its own tool, so nothing has to be guessed from shape.
WebFetch's toolResponse reports bytes/code/durationMs/url and the fetched text as `result`.
No domain or snippet is reported for a search result, so a card derives the host from the URL.
Long strings are truncated with an ellipsis and result lists cut to three; field names and nesting
